content.short: BendDAO provides NFT-backed lending allowing users to borrow ETH by putting NFTs up as collateral.
content.description: BendDAO is an NFT lending service that enables instant NFT-backed loans and supports Collateral Listing and NFT Down Payment. Historically, BendDAO allowed loans of up to 40% of the collateral value. A liquidation crisis triggered a vote to lower the liquidation threshold and make liquidations easier, encouraging lenders to stay in the ecosystem with higher interest rates. Borrowers also have a 24-hour liquidation protection period to repay the loan, during which liquidation actions are paused.
content.meta: BendDAO is a peer-to-pool lending service allowing users to put NFTs up in exchange for ETH. Discover BendDAO and other NFT Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
